title: Descent of a specified parameter sublist from a strict local ring
statement: Let W be any locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], w a point and t:Spec(Omega)->W a geometric point above w [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let a be an ordered finite list of global regular functions. Map these functions to the recorded strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] by the canonical geometric germs [def-trf-log-regular-pair] and ring comparison [def-trf-log-etale-restriction-stalk-comparison]. Suppose the strict henselization is local and Noetherian and that this image list extends to a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. Then the ordinary germs of exactly the given list a, in the same order, extend to a regular system of parameters of O_(W,w).

source.place: Tag 06LN (lemma-henselization-regular), proof using minimal generators and residue extension; Tag 07QM; algebra.tex Tags 00KU and 00DV. Specified-prefix consequence used in steps 5--6 of lem-trf-free-log-chart-ordinary-parameters.

proof.text: Choose a Noetherian affine neighbourhood of w and use the ordinary-stalk localization and affine strict-local comparison, preserving the canonical maps of all specified functions. Thus A is the algebraic strict henselization of B=O_(W,w).

A full list of dim A generators of the maximal ideal makes A regular: its spanFinrank is at most the list length, and Krull dimension is at most spanFinrank. Its cotangent classes span and have cardinality equal to their vector-space dimension, so are a basis. In particular the specified prefix classes are independent.

Regularity descends from A to B. The canonical cotangent base-change map carries each prescribed class tensored with 1 to the corresponding class in A. Faithfulness of the residue-field extension descends their linear independence.

Extend these independent classes to a basis of the finite-dimensional cotangent space of B and lift the added vectors to m_B. Nakayama makes the concatenated list generate m_B. By regularity its length is dim B, so it is a regular system of parameters with precisely the prescribed prefix. The empty prefix and dimension-zero case are included.

from.place: Steps of the ordinary-parameter proof, factored without changing its statement or the unit route.

lean.statement:
theorem strictLocal_parameters_descent
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian W]
    (w : W) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ W) (ht : (Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω W t).1 = w)
    (a : List Γ(W, ⊤))
    (ha : ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing t))
        (_ : IsNoetherianRing (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing t)),
      ∃ b : List (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing t),
        IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters
          (a.map (fun f ↦ (strictLocalRingStrictHenselizationIso W t).hom
            (strictLocalGerm W t (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W))
              (CategoryTheory.Over.homMk t (by simp)) f)) ++ b)) :
    ∃ b : List (W.presheaf.stalk w),
        IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters
          (a.map (fun f ↦ W.presheaf.germ ⊤ w (by trivial) f) ++ b)
